record.rationale: Browser-only fill-item records preserve concrete native item classes, raw full enum, transparency/bool state and named/indexed resolved/complex color ownership. Indexed colors use a read-only view of their actual private resolved payload because the native getter requires non-indexed state; no palette resolution or source mutation is synthesized.
